_comment: Where the build gets its art. Swapping a source here changes the game's look without touching code — the loader matches models by category and filename hint.

map._comment: Ready-made levels, tried in order. The first that downloads and holds a model becomes the world; the assembled town is the fallback and is always available.
map.note: Neither host is reachable from the development sandbox, so the build runner is the only place these can be fetched. The build reports what it got.
